notes: Track 0 Sec 8/9: the Schedule A composition total is computed whenever a Form 1098 statement is on record (needed for the attachment's required-vs-not-required comparison itself, independent of whether it wins the line-12e max()). Line 8a is the only populated category for this bounded class, so this rule's own value is exactly tax.us.2025.schedule-a.line8a. This is the count > 0 producer of tax.us.2025.schedule-a.total; rule.schedule-a-total-closed-empty.json is the count == 0 producer of the same symbol (mutually exclusive guards, so exactly one of the two ever publishes for a given return - the runner's ordinary same-symbol multi-producer handling, not a conflict). requires makes tax.us.2025.schedule-a.line8a a true saturation-order dependency (not just a value-level ref) so this rule is correctly deferred to a later saturation pass rather than attempted eagerly before line8a.rule has published in the same pass. Core v67 (gambling-losses): the total is line 8a plus Schedule A line 16 (gambling losses limited to winnings), so it requires both.
